paras: When your Paragon Performance 2-piece rotors need new friction rings, these are the direct replacement rotor rings engineered to restore your braking system to factory-fresh performance. Designed specifically for the F8x M2, M3, and M4 platform with blue calipers, these 370x24mm rear rotor rings deliver the same precision and thermal management you expect from Paragon Performance.

Machined from CM-250 cast iron using CBN (Cubic Boron Nitride) precision grinding, each rotor ring features directional ventilation vanes that run up to 30% cooler than OEM rotors and increase cooling efficiency by up to 30%. The floating 2-piece design and slotted face pattern work together to minimise brake fade and judder during extended track sessions — keeping your pedal feel consistent lap after lap.
